body: Dave corrected the Sep 1 Vanilla Bomb finishing plan. Do NOT use the prior frosting assumption. Actual finish ingredients now shown: Betty Crocker Whipped Butter Cream frosting, plus Nestle Coffee Mate Pumpkin Spice non-dairy creamer. Intended move: blend the whipped butter cream frosting with pumpkin spice creamer for the cake finish. This correction should supersede the prior relay's frosting ambiguity for this specific Vanilla Bomb lineage. Preserve the batter build separately. Done when future lanes recall the Butter Cream + Pumpkin Spice creamer finish as the current frosting plan.
